jobs.title: Data Engineer, Amazon Security Experience
jobs.description: The Amazon Security Experiences (ASE) organization is the data intelligence backbone of Amazon Security. We build and operate the data platform that powers security insights, builder experience analytics, and tooling decisions across Amazon's security ecosystem. Every insight surfaced to security leadership, from builder productivity trends to security issue quality metrics, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains. We operate at scale, processing large volumes of security and operational data daily through hundreds of pipelines consisting of transformations, reporting queries, ingestions, and infrastructure management scripts. Our engineers work directly with source systems across AWS and SDO (Security, Developer, and Operations) data domains to procure data, convert it into structured formats, build large-scale processing pipelines, design analytical data models, and maintain infrastructure with the highest security and compliance standards. We are seeking a Data Engineer I to join our Security Data Intelligence (SDI) team. In this role, you will build and maintain data pipelines that power security analytics across Amazon. Working with well-defined requirements and guidance from senior engineers, you will create physical data models, optimize data pipelines for defined datasets, and deliver reliable, well-documented solutions on schedule. You will partner with teams across ASE, BizOps, MapSec, and other security organizations to implement data ingestion flows and support analytical models that serve the broader Amazon Security organization. Key job responsibilities Learn and apply team-established data processing guidelines and best practices when building and testing pipelines. Measure and improve dataset quality across owned pipelines, identifying issues and proposing solutions to the team. Flag limitations or opportunities in data processing tools to senior engineers for evaluation. Learn and understand the team's existing data architecture, including how security data flows through ingestion, transformation, and serving layers. Build data solutions at the component level within the established team data architecture, following defined logical data models. Create physical data models for assigned datasets, applying appropriate persistence and integration techniques. Understand the implications of implementation decisions (e.g., normalization, distribution) and seek guidance from senior engineers on trade-offs. Write secure, stable, testable, and maintainable code with minimal defects, following team coding standards. Clearly document solutions for ease of use and maintainability by teammates and data consumers. Get all data models, pipeline designs, and code reviewed by senior engineers before deployment. Test code thoroughly and understand the maintenance characteristics, runtime properties, and dependencies of delivered solutions. Build and maintain data pipeline infrastructure for assigned datasets using team-established patterns and tools. Apply basic database optimization techniques such as partitioning, distribution, and indexing as directed. Understand the underlying system infrastructure that data solutions depend on, including differences between data persistence solutions. Follow team guidelines for infrastructure management, security compliance, and automation practices. Solve straightforward, well-defined problems with guidance from senior engineers, for example, building ingestion pipelines for a new security data source where the schema and requirements are defined, or troubleshooting data quality issues in existing datasets by researching root causes and thoroughly resolving defects. Handle problems even outside your own domain by either resolving them or ensuring a clear hand-off to the right owner. Take well-defined requirements and deliver solutions on schedule within assigned scope. Participate in team design, scoping, and prioritization discussions to understand project context. Manage your own task execution effectively, seeking guidance when blocked or uncertain. Communicate progress and dependencies clearly to your team lead and senior engineers. Build good working relationships with teammates, peer engineers, and data consumers across ASE and SDO. Partner effectively with Business Analysts, Data Scientists, and peer SDEs to understand data requirements. Help train and mentor DE interns when applicable. Participate in the interview process. Recognize discordant views and participate in constructive dialogue with peers. Follow team-established best practices for data discovery, naming conventions, and data security. Classify, store, and handle data per Amazon security and compliance policies. Ensure proper access control, data integrity, and auditability for all produced datasets. Track security risks in data handling, mitigate issues, and escalate in a timely manner. Identify data quality issues and pipeline deficiencies in owned components and propose solutions to the team. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team planning sessions. Make small improvements to team development processes when directed. Actively seek knowledge of team data architecture and apply learnings to improve your data solutions. Participate in on-call rotation and respond to pipeline incidents following established runbooks and escalation procedures. Understand the maintenance characteristics, runtime properties, and dependencies of team data systems. Contribute to monitoring and alarming setup for owned pipelines with guidance from senior engineers. Document incident resolutions and contribute to runbook updates for owned components. - 2+ years of data engineering experience - Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines - Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala) - Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell) - Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR - Experience with any ETL tool like, Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI, Datastage, etc. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.description: The Amazon Specialized Business Security (SBS) Core Proactive Security team designs and engineers security solutions to protect high-profile devices and consumer experiences including the best-selling Kindle family of products, offerings such as Amazon Photos and innovative devices like Amazon Echo, Fire tablets, Amazon Fire TV, Echo Show, Echo Spot. You will own the design of major security tooling, infrastructure, define development roadmaps, own key deliverables and have opportunities to build them from scratch. You will lead and mentor other talented engineers. You will be responsible for building the best customer experience, keeping latency, security, and usability in mind. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Predictive Targeting
jobs.description: Want to build systems where machine learning and AI agents decide, in real time, which customers Amazon reaches across its marketing channels? The Predictive Targeting team is reinventing how Amazon targets its marketing as an AI-native, self-improving system — and we need a strong Software Development Engineer II to help build it. Today a marketer hand-picks audiences with manual rules and makes dozens of undocumented judgment calls to get there. We are replacing that with an agentic workflow: a marketer describes a goal in plain language, and the system compiles it step by step and auditably into a scored, measurable customer audience, then closes the loop by measuring live results, learning what worked, and improving the next run. You will own the engineering behind that loop: distributed services and agent tooling that turn an objective into an audience, score it, and keep refining it. The platform runs worldwide across more than a dozen marketplaces on customer signals refreshed daily, and must start optimizing at day 1 of a campaign, under guardrails that protect the customer experience. As an SDE II you will own features end to end, from design through production and on-call, make smart trade-offs in an ambiguous and fast-moving space, and raise the bar for the engineers around you. You thrive without a fully specified problem, you sweat the details at scale, and you want your code to move a real business metric. Key job responsibilities In this role, you will: - Design and build innovative GenAI and agentic solutions in a large distributed computing environment, and help lead fundamental changes in how marketing targeting works. - Create scalable solutions that run machine-learning predictions and agent-driven decisions on distributed systems, at incredible scale and speed. - Build distributed storage, indexing, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low-cost, and easy to operate. - Turn broadly defined, ambiguous problems into the right technical solutions — and ship the code behind them. - Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software, owning features end to end from design through production and on-call. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - Amazon MSK, Managed Streaming for Kafka
jobs.description: Come build the future of data streaming with the Amazon Managed Streaming for Kafka (MSK) team! We are seeking builders for our Amazon MSK service, a fully managed service that makes it easy for customers to build and run applications that use Apache Kafka to process streaming data. We are looking for engineers who are enthusiastic about data streaming, and are as passionate about contributing to open source as they are about solving real customers' business needs, at AWS scale. As a member of the Amazon MSK team, you will be making contributions to the entire core data plane stack that make up the MSK service, the core Kafka platform, and stand-alone tools that make it easier for Kafka community to operate Kafka better. Upstream compatibility is a core tenet of MSK. Your code changes to the Kafka platform will be released back to open source. As a member of an AWS service that builds on top of a popular open source technology, this is a unique opportunity to work on a team that straddles both worlds – open source and Amazon-internal software. You will design and build new features, make performance improvements, identify and investigate new technologies, prototype solutions, build scalable services, and test and review changes, to deliver an exceptional customer experience. The ideal candidate has experience designing large-scale systems supporting millions of transactions per second, enjoys solving complex software problems, and possesses analytical, design and problem-solving skills. Ideally you have an in-depth understanding of streaming data technologies like Amazon Kinesis or Apache Kafka, and experience with open-source data processing frameworks like Apache Spark, Apache Flink, or Apache Storm. Your responsibilities will include collaborating with other engineers to build a large scale AWS service, and work with senior leaders to define your team's roadmap, including identifying design and code changes needed in the underlying open source platforms. Learn more about Amazon MSK: - AWS re:Invent 2018: Amazon Managed Streaming for Kafka (Amazon MSK) Launch * AWS re:Invent 2020: How Goldman Sachs uses an Amazon MSK backbone for Transaction Banking Platform * AWS re:Invent 2020: How New Relic is migrating its Apache Kafka cluster to Amazon MSK * AWS re:Invent 2021: How Coinbase uses Amazon MSK as an event store for applications * MSK Tiered Storage: Optimize cost and improve Kafka scalability * AWS re:Invent 2023: How Rivian builds real-time analytics from electric vehicles Utility Computing (UC) AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. About the team About AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. jobs.description: Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity. Are you passionate about developing mission-critical software systems? As part of the Atlas team, you'll build and maintain the backbone software infrastructure that powers our entire organization. Your work will include: - Creating systems and services for ingesting, processing, and visualizing vast amounts of satellite telemetry data - Building real-time monitoring systems to identify anomalies, detect emerging trends, and proactively alert stakeholders to critical situations that require intervention - Ensuring extremely high reliability, uptime, and performance across systems that receive and manage telemetry streams from thousands of endpoint The systems we build serve a fundamental role in the successful functioning of the satellite constellation, and several supporting teams. They depend on us to have mission-critical reliability, uptime, and performance. Key job responsibilities - Develop software systems that meet the mission criteria and requirements. - Collaborate with your fellow team members to form a strong foundation for a software organization in Leo. - Help on-board new team members. - Utilize AWS and other Amazon technologies to build high-available software services.
